description: This PHP source file defines a Migration class for version 5.6.1 of the OrangeHRM system, responsible for updating display field class names based on field aliases during a database migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class for updating display field class names in OrangeHRM version 5.6.1.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration, updating display field class names.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassNames
methods.description: Updates class names for specific display fields based on their aliases.

methods.description: Retrieves the display field ID for a given field alias.

methods.name: updateDisplayFieldClassById
methods.description: Updates the class name of a display field by its ID.
